design.carm: N real C-ArmLSpine frames = both views of N/2 training patients, the committed nested subsets (seeds 0, 1, 2)
design.carm_view: one protocol only: the AP (or LAT) frame of the 25 / 50 patients of the both-view N = 50 / 100 subsets
design.cobra: N real COBRA Elekta XVI frames: N/2 training patients, per patient the frame nearest AP and the frame nearest lateral
design.styled: N styled renders of this device's geometry, posed under the SAME patients' registered AP and LAT poses as the matched carm cell
design.carm_outline: CONVENTION CONTROL, added 2026-09-24 after box_style showed the body step is the box drawn: the SAME 24 C-ArmLSpine frames as carm N = 24 of each seed, relabelled from their meta with whole-vertebra outline boxes (the background's convention; tools/lcurve_fill.py outline_labels, every frame's meta first shown to reproduce its released body label), with best.pt chosen on the outline-labelled C-ArmLSpine val split; and N = 0 on the same outline val. N = 0 and N = 24 of this arm differ only by the 24 frames

summary.rule: min and max over the four one-view arms (25 and 50 frames x anteroposterior and lateral), each pooled over its two seeds, body boxes at confidence 0.74; 'own' = read on the protocol trained on, 'other' = read on the other protocol

caveats: Every cell selects its checkpoint on the C-ArmLSpine VAL split (28 frames, 14 patients), the COBRA and styled arms included, exactly as the committed curve did; val is never counted in N and never overlaps the test patients.

The stage-2 background carries this device's own-geometry styled renders, posed under the registered poses of C-ArmLSpine patients, the 28 test patients among them (pose donors, not the patients). This is identical in every cell, N = 0 included.
The committed cells (N0 s0, N50 s0, N100, N200) trained on the pre-repair C-ArmLSpine labels; the fill cells on the rebuilt labels. The images are byte-identical; the label change is in `repair`.

COBRA frames carry fewer vertebra boxes than C-ArmLSpine frames (the Elekta pelvic field): the matched arm is matched in frames, patients and views, not in boxes (`training_vertebra_boxes`). COBRA training truth is whole-vertebra, so its arm is read in both conventions.

The COBRA frames of the matched arm are already in the stage-1 list (all 2,640 COBRA train frames, twice); the arm tests whether filling the same epoch slot with another device's frames does what this device's frames do.
Requested N = 5 and 25 are realized as 4 and 24 frames (2 frames per patient; lcurve_lists.draw tie rule).

The styled renders of the matched arm come from the same own-geometry train directory that is already in the stage-2 background once each. Like the COBRA arm, the styled arm up-weights frames the model already sees, while the C-ArmLSpine arm adds frames it has never seen. That is the design (what the same epoch slot does when filled from elsewhere), and it is why N = 0 is the matched floor for all three arms.

BOX CONVENTION. Every arm without C-ArmLSpine frames learns its boxes from whole-vertebra truth (COBRA, DeepFluoro, the styled renders). On the lateral view the C-ArmLSpine body box and the whole-vertebra outline box overlap too little for a whole-vertebra prediction to reach IoU 0.5 with the body truth (`box_style.truth_body_vs_outline_iou`). The body-convention step from N = 0 to N = 4 is therefore mostly the detector adopting the body box, not finding vertebrae it could not find: `box_style` counts it and the render shows it. The effect of in-domain frames on localisation is the `centre` reading.
The out-of-domain arms still select their checkpoint on C-ArmLSpine VAL, as every cell does, so they see target labels at selection; if anything this favours them.

The convention control (`carm_outline`) selects best.pt on OUTLINE-labelled C-ArmLSpine val (same 14 patients); every other cell on body-labelled val. Its own N = 0 isolates what the val convention does through selection (contrast 'N=0 outline val vs N=0 body val'). Its training frames are the carm N = 24 frames byte for byte; only the label boxes differ (outline_labels.json: every frame's meta reproduced its released body label before the outline label was written; 0 boxes fell back to the body box).

Held out: every cell (45) passed tools/eval_gate.py at scoring (overlap 0, unresolved 0, 28 test patients keyed) and the independent list intersection (0 test patients in the cell's or stage 1's train + val lists). Pose-donor overlap (28 test patients as pose donors of the own-geometry styled renders in the shared background) is reported by the gate in every cell.

One array task (lc_surgio_b51_dr_N24_s1_xSTYLED, 40427581_26) was handed a GPU torch could not see on msa1, trained on CPU for 4 h and was cancelled; its run directory is kept as *.cpu_hung_40427581_26 and the cell was retrained on msa3 (40429284). lcurve_fill.sh now refuses to start without CUDA.
